en: A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a long metal truss bridge over a wide, mostly dry riverbed in a barren landscape with low hills in the background. The scene is minimal, focusing on the bridge structure stretching horizontally across the image. There is printed text in Greek at the lower left and in English at the lower right, and a round emblem plus a website watermark near the bottom.
